title: The Last Safehouse
author: Quentin Dravenmoor
blurb: Odile Oyelaran, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. But when every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must trade the one secret worth killing for, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
